_meta.source: Kalshi public trade API (https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?series_ticker=<S>&status=open), downloaded by the engine's own adapter on the GitHub runner
_meta.note: Real market objects from the first live reading (state/raw/kalshi on the data branch), the fields this project reads, written back in the API's shape (prices as strings with four decimals, volumes with two; strikes as the API prints them). KXBRENTW, KXBRENTD, KXWTIW, KXHORMUZNORM, KXHORMUZWEEKLY, KXMAXSHIPSHORMUZ, KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT, KXUSIRANMEETING, KXEIACRUDEW complete; KXWTI (the 15th and the Nov 3 ladder) and KXBRENTMON thinned to every 2nd/5th/3rd strike; the 14th's WTI ladder left out. Each event keeps the rules on its first market only. KXCLOSEHORMUZ, KXHORMUZRETURN, KXOPECCUTS, KXSAUDICRUDE and KXWTIMONTHLY answered no open market that night.
